fact: Avenirguinee reports that the registration of primary pupils under a single matricule number was launched in Matoto commune on 5 March 2026 before the heads of public and private schools, that the operation runs from 5 to 25 March 2026 across the whole national territory, and that the matricule, used in collège and lycée since 2022, traces each pupil's path and detects any transfer between schools; it adds that in 2025 the DGECS's digitalisation had brought automated pupil transfers and digital management of the marks of intermediate classes; it gives no count of pupils or schools registered and does not say who keys the data.
title: Guinée : Lancement de l'immatriculation unique des élèves à Matoto
